findings.resolution_summary: The current supported disposable install/refresh/remove records all 77 actual owned payload files, including nine agents, ten launched skills and their metadata, workflows, controller and extensions. Current per-file digests and exact coordinates are retained separately from historical receipts; consumer configuration and unrelated workflow preservation are explicit. Independently rerunning the snapshot test passed and exercised all 15 SI helper cases. This eliminates the recorded absent-inventory deficiency; it does not imply complete lifecycle/scope coverage or native/manual evidence.
